Malnutrition and CF
Malnutrition in CF patients is still one of the main clinical manifestations despite increased knowledge and improved management.
Of adults with CF, 60.8% have a BMI below the recommended levels and 15.7% of patients under 20 are below the ﬁfth centile
weight-for-age and gender.
A clear link has been shown between good nutrition and prognosis of CF. BMI percentiles in children and BMI values in adults
are also directly and strongly correlated with pulmonary function in terms of FEV1 (Figure 4).
